what: Photos stacked in one spot fade to the next at a set interval (default 3s). If a progress bar is present it fills linearly over that interval and the slide changes the moment it fills, with the page count (01 — 03) changing along with it. Default curve is flickity drag physics (half at .2s, 90% at .5s, stops at 1.5s)

options.zoom-back: Photos in sections that turn off with on also recede to the zoom scale with zoom-dur·zoom-ease, and sections turning on continue approaching from the current scale (like a CSS transition) · Place 1 ↔ 1.02, 4s
options.fade: Fade length (seconds), default 2 (the settle curve rests at about 1.5s) — reference Hero 3
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One photo (needs two or more to rotate)
options.[data-fx-part=now]·[data-fx-part=total]: (If any) two-digit current page / total pages
options.zoom: Starting scale of the incoming section’s first child (photo) — if given, it approaches 1 from that scale (Ken Burns), default 1 (off) · one variant uses 1.15
options.zoom-dur: Approach duration (seconds), default same as fade · Brand site 9.5
options.intro: If “fade”, the first section also rises from 0 with the fade length and curve (default is visible from the start) · Brand
options.first: Delay until the first switch (seconds), same as the default every — for switching several panels in staggered order (three About photos of Brand: every 9 · first 3·6·9)
options.on: when event, it starts spinning when an fx:play event arrives on the element (default: right on attach) — brand: the page script sends it to the three panels together when the section is 30% visible
options.zoom-to: Target scale to approach, default 1 — above 1, the incoming page scales up to that value from zoom (zoom-in) · Brand zoom 1 → zoom-to 1.05
options.out: ”hold” keeps the previous section as is and only the new section floats up on top during the fade, then hides the previous one — Studio carousel fade where the background doesn’t show through during the overlap · Brand
options.start: ”random” picks the first section at random each time it opens (default is the first section) · corp-brand Hero
options.fade-out: Fade length of the section going off (sec), same as fade by default — the Brand first photo is in 1.2 · out .8
options.out-ease: Only the closing section has a different curve (form ”0.55,0.085,0.68,0.53”), same as the default ease — Brand on .25,.46,.45,.94 · off .55,.085,.68,.53
options.view: if pause, the crossfade clock stops while the plate is off-screen and resumes when it re-enters (reference crossfade — ScrollTrigger top bottom ~ bottom top plays only there)
options.click: If next, clicking the panel advances immediately to the next section and restarts the interval timing (original .js-enable-click)

use: 01 — 02
note: Sends an fx:change event (detail.index) on the element at each slide — use it to change nearby text together
